headline: Every missed call and enquiry, answered and booked into your diary
sub: When your front desk is busy or the clinic is closed, people who call or message still get an answer and an appointment, so fewer of them try the next clinic on their list.

cards.title: Calls answered while you treat
cards.text: When the desk cannot pick up, the call is still answered and the caller is offered a time, instead of hearing it ring out.

cards.title: Enquiries booked after hours
cards.text: Evening and weekend enquiries get a reply and a slot there and then, so they are not waiting for Monday morning.

cards.title: Straight into your diary
cards.text: Bookings, changes and cancellations go into the diary you already use, so your team starts the day with it up to date.

closing: Ready to stop enquiries going unanswered?
